title: Remove Completed render flat export
summary: Removed the transitional flat window.renderCompleted export from the Completed WebView module while preserving namespace access through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.renderCompleted.
reason: The WebView cleanup workstream is reducing legacy flat window exports by touched domain while keeping backend-owned behavior and intentional test hooks intact.
behavior_before: completedView.js published renderCompleted both through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView and as a direct window.renderCompleted compatibility alias, and several WebView smokes required the flat alias.
behavior_after: completedView.js exposes renderCompleted through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView only; touched WebView and rendered-HTML tests require namespace access and assert the direct flat assignment is absent.
tests_added: Strengthened LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert completedView.js no longer contains window.renderCompleted = renderCompleted.
Updated touched WebView smoke harnesses to require window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.renderCompleted instead of the flat renderCompleted export.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_diagnostics_owner_handoff_smoke -q passed after adding a minimal document.body fixture to the touched Node harness.
git diff --check passed with line-ending warnings only.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet's completedView.js alias removal, WebView smoke namespace updates, inventory/current-state/generated-summary updates, generated public contract baseline, and packet changes; rerun the touched WebView smokes and webview:prework:check to confirm rollback behavior.
notes:
Remove the transitional direct renderCompleted window export.
Require Completed rendering through mediaPipelineCompletedView namespace.
Update namespace usage and add minimal document body fixture for pending-publish rendering.
Assert the backend-served prototype no longer exposes the direct renderCompleted alias.
Update WebView flat export cleanup progress count.
Update flat export inventory for completedView cleanup.
Refresh WebView public contract baseline after flat export cleanup.
Refresh generated summary after WebView flat export cleanup.
No source media paths, backend mutation routes, pending-publish drain behavior, or media-policy code paths are changed by this packet; real-media validation is not required for this WebView-only cleanup.
